name: us030-personal-created-then-loads
description: 030 US3, FR-027, C2.6, SC-006: run 1 creates personal.yml (team commented out); run 2 (a second ceremony) must load it without refusing — this is the scenario that catches a regression of the team-optional early return (an absent `team` key wrongly scored as `team is invalid`). Two runs sharing one workdir; both succeed, byte-identical across ports.
